candidates.change_summary: Remove the onlyOwner modifier from withdrawAll, allowing anyone to call it.
Replace withdraw with a direct transfer to msg.sender, bypassing internal withdraw logic and onlyOwner check.
Replace address(this).balance with a different value, e.g. zero, so withdraw transfers 0 ether instead of full balance.
Change require(msg.sender == owner) to always true, allowing anyone to bypass onlyOwner check.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from withdraw(uint256) so anyone can call it.
Replace `payable(msg.sender).transfer(_value)` with sending to a fixed address, e.g. owner, changing who receives funds.
Delete the require statement in onlyOwner modifier, allowing anyone to pass the check.
Change ownership check from msg.sender to tx.origin, altering who can pass the modifier.
Replace `payable(msg.sender).transfer(_value)` with a call that does nothing (no value transferred), so balance stays unchanged.
